infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Voya uses Face ID to let you back in without typing your password.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Voya reads your location once when you choose to share it with your travelers. It is never stored.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Voya uses the camera to translate menus, signs and receipts. Photos are read once and never stored.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Voya reads a photo you choose to translate it. Nothing is uploaded or kept.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Voya uses the microphone for spoken translation when a speech module is installed.
